messages:
sam (sales): urgent: CruxLab POC flaking under load - getting 429s + a handful of 500s during their integration test. Demo tomorrow 11am ET. Can we triage now?

meera (solutions): what's their concurrency and model? any sample error body/logs?

sam (sales): ~30 parallel workers hitting chat with avg 450 token contexts, model=redwood-7b-chat. Errors: 

{"status":429, "error":"rate_limit"}
{"status":500, "error":"kernel_alloc_fail"}

kai (eng-runtime): sounds like transient backend saturation + missing client retries. Short term: 1) enable per-org soft QPS bump, 2) enforce client-side backoff header, 3) if needed route them to a 3b variant. Which do you want first?

sre_oncall: I can apply a +20% soft QPS for 2h. Also seeing a few worker pod restarts at 03:12 UTC; will check crash logs.

meera (solutions): Sam ask the customer if fidelity can drop a bit for demo. If yes, model fallback is fastest mitigation without infra changes.

sam (sales): Customer says shorted replies are OK for demo. Please do fallback + QPS bump. Also they asked about Dedicated timelines — who can confirm? @erin

erin (acctmgr): Dedicated normally 48h. For trial POCs we can sometimes do 24h with approval. I'll standby to provide rough pricing.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Rolling config: infra/org-qps v1.4 -> canary. ETA 5m.

kai (eng-runtime): Routing rule added for org=cruxlab -> prefer redwood-3b-chat for new sessions. Also injected `x-suggested-backoff-ms:150` header. Monitoring.

sre_oncall: Soft QPS bump applied at 03:25 UTC. Pod restarts stopped after bump, error rate dropped to ~0.6%.

sam (sales): Customer re-tested: p50 430ms, p95 ~980ms, sporadic 500s down to 0.5%. Demo green. Thanks folks.

meera (solutions): I'll draft a short runbook: client backoff snippet, model fallback list, and recommended Dedicated sizing if they move to prod.

erin (acctmgr): I'll prepare a 30-day Dedicated quote and include KMS/VPC options.

sam (sales): Closing thread. Will reopen if post-demo issues. :thumbsup:
